{{Otheruses|Huttball}}
[[File:Frog-dogs_team_logo.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A Huttball arena]]
'''Huttball''' was a dangerous sport that was popular on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Old Republic era]]. The game pitted two randomly selected teams against one another in a no-holds-barred attempt to gain possession of [[Huttball (object)/Legends|the ball]] and bring it into the opposing team's camp. Violence and cheating were encouraged in Huttball. Sponsored by the famed [[Giradda]] the Hutt, Huttball pitted some of the most powerful heroes in the galaxy in a contest with fame and fortune at stake.<ref name="HB">{{TORweb|url=info/media/trailers/huttball|text=Trailer - Huttball}}</ref>
